pages.text: A giant pair of Crushing Wheels that can process players should they choose to get processed either by stupidity or accident. Unlike Millstones, Crushing Wheels can process an entire stack at a time which is significantly faster at scale. May also have additional recipes exclusive to Crushing Wheels.

For correct rotational direction, use a Gearbox behind both Crushing Wheels and a Shaft BETWEEN the gearboxes. This ensures they are always rotating in the correct direction in either a horizontal orientation with a conveyor belt or in a vertical position with Chutes/Smart Chutes on the top.
